wins.label: Network Transformation Progress
wins.evidence: Our network transformation actions will drive improved profitability by unlocking efficiencies, improving density, and creating a more flexible network.

wins.label: DRIVE Savings Progress
wins.evidence: In the first quarter, we achieved $390 million of DRIVE-related savings.

wins.label: Pricing Actions
wins.evidence: We have recently implemented significant new pricing actions relating to both demand and fuel surcharges, which will benefit us in the coming quarters.

wins.label: Tricolor Implementation
wins.evidence: The implementation of Tricolor, which is the redesign of our global air network, is well underway.

wins.label: Improved Service Levels in Europe
wins.evidence: I'm encouraged by the progress we are making in Europe, improving service levels, reducing churn, and winning new business despite difficult market conditions.

risks.label: Weaker Industrial Economy
risks.evidence: Weakness in the industrial economy pressured our B2B volumes, particularly in the U.S.

risks.label: Shift to Lower-Yielding Services
risks.evidence: We saw increasing demand for our lower-yielding services, and some of this demand increase was driven by a shift in customer preference worldwide from priority to deferred services.

risks.label: U.S. Postal Service Contract Expiration
risks.evidence: We will be making network adjustments post expiration of the U.S. Postal Service contract.

risks.label: Challenging Pricing Environment
risks.evidence: We are operating in a very competitive but still rational pricing environment.

risks.label: Lower Revenue Growth Expectations
risks.evidence: We now expect revenue to grow at low single-digit rate.

risks.label: Weak Demand Environment

risks.label: Industrial Economy Pressure

risks.label: International Economy Headwinds
risks.evidence: “Yield remained positive, driven by higher base rates and fuel surcharges, with growth partially offset by a tapering of international export demand surcharges.”

risks.label: Postal Service Contract Termination
risks.evidence: “As we shared last quarter, we are conducting an assessment of the role of FedEx Freight in our portfolio structure. The assessment is well underway and on track to be completed by the end of the calendar year, all while we continue to deliver safe and reliable service to our customers.”

risks.label: Competitive Pricing Pressure
risks.evidence: “Against this backdrop, we maintain our focus on revenue quality and continue to grow the yield in the first quarter but at a lower rate than we expected, especially here in the United States.”
